Code signing of a release proceeds inside-out, individually signs XPC services, Autoupdate, Updater.app and the framework with runtime and timestamp, then signs the host with its existing Apple Events entitlement. The verifying code checks team, certificate, identifier, runtime, entitlements and timestamp on every architecture. Independently verified these checks on both extracted A and B Developer ID QA archives, including five universal components in each. The QA hosts are arm64.",
    "Inspected allowlisted framework links, inventory modes, ZIP path/target/descendant checks, trusted pre-sign bytes, read-only DMG inspection and dual ticket and Gatekeeper checks. The internal beta regression now allows only the approved framework links, pins its entire upstream content and Package.resolved, rejects modified content, and can inspect historical packages. Independently ran 23 packaging, 19 internal beta packaging, and 125 release readiness tests, all passing, including temporary native disk-image creation and inspection.",
    "Reviewed the LSUIElement launch guard: a single instance must own the normal app data lock and be running ordinary capture mode from its app bundle. One updater owns manual checks from the menu and settings, automatic-check preference, scheduled gentle reminder, error presentation and download website link. Automatic installs are disabled.     "The HTTPS feed requires Ed25519 validation without an expiry fallback, archive validation before extraction and advancing marketing/build versions. CI verifies the transition against the real event base. Independently ran all 10 appcast tests with official Sparkle tools and an ephemeral signed QA DMG. Enforcement of the designated Team and bundle for official feed generation is independent from Sparkle's own support for identity rotation.",

The fixture binaries predate the last markup/quit refinements, which have their own source and isolated regression evidence.",
